text:
Olivia Hu: Quick sync — we need to lock the mapping of tenant quota types to reserved pool tiers before sprint planning. Acme wants predictable burst, FinCorp cares about hard limits.
Matt G.: Drafted a mapping proposal earlier today, posting here for feedback. TL;DR: three pool tiers (bronze/silver/gold) + an elastic spillover guardrail.
Sara P.: can you paste the matrix? easier to react to numbers than words.
Matt G.: sure — example config (pseudocode):
```
{
  "gold": { "min_qps": 100, "burst_tokens": 50, "preemptible": false },
  "silver": { "min_qps": 30, "burst_tokens": 20, "preemptible": true },
  "bronze": { "min_qps": 5, "burst_tokens": 5, "preemptible": true }
}
```
Devon K.: ok but how do burst_tokens map to seconds at p95 latency? need a conversion so SRE/QA can simulate.
Matt G.: good call — rough conversion: tokens ~= concurrent requests * average tokens-per-request. For our 2xx workload avg 40 tokens, so 50 tokens ~ 1.25 concurrent large requests. We should provide min_qps and sustained_qps too.
Leah Y.: customer ask: FinCorp requires "hard quota enforcement" for regulatory reasons. That means bronze/silver can be throttled/spillover but gold must never be evicted except planned maintenance. Is that feasible?
Olivia Hu: yes but we need runbook changes & SLA text. Also need to decide if gold gets reserved preemption credits so it never loses capacity to autoscale.
Matt G.: proposal: gold = pinned capacity (no preemption), silver = reserved + preemptible burst pool, bronze = best-effort shared pool. Autoscale policy: ramp windows are 30s for gold, 60s for silver, 120s for bronze.
Sara P.: acceptance criteria for GA? let's be concrete — what tests/metrics must pass?
Devon K.: from eng side: 1) p95 tail latency during 1-min synthetic spike < 1200ms for gold, <1500ms for silver, <2000ms for bronze; 2) no request loss for gold under load up to reserved capacity; 3) preemption/recovery behavior for silver documented and tested; 4) canary rollout with 5 tenants then 25 then 100.
Leah Y.: product/legal: must also have audit log entries for each preemption event and ability to export per-tenant SLA violations monthly. Add that to telemetry.
Matt G.: noted. Need new telemetry: preemption_count, preemption_reason, bytes_saved_by_burst_cache, spillover_rate. I'll open an infra ticket.
Olivia Hu: timeline: alpha (internal) next week, beta with 5 early customers in 3 weeks, GA in 10 weeks pending metrics. We should define rollback criteria.
Devon K.: rollback criteria proposal: if >2 tenants experience p90 latency regressions >30% vs baseline for 10m, or if preemption_count spikes >20/min across system during canary, then automatic rollback. release-bot: will trigger rollback if thresholds breached.
release-bot: deploy plan created: pipeline #1234, canary group size 5, monitor window 15m.
Sara P.: migration plan for legacy reserved customers? many are on older quota API. We need a mapping tool that suggests a pool tier and burst tokens based on historical 30-day p95 and 95th percentile qps.
Matt G.: I've sketched a heuristic: take 95th qps * 1.2 -> min_qps target; burst_tokens = ceil(95th concurrent / avg_tokens). We'll include a "suggested_tier" output.
Leah Y.: also surface pricing change implications in console — we can't surprise customers during migration. Product needs a note in the Billing UI and email template.
Olivia Hu: agree. Action items: Matt -> create infra ticket for telemetry & config fields (due EOD Thu); Devon -> implement canary + rollback hooks (in this sprint); Sara -> migration heuristic + UI text; Leah -> customer comms + SLA wording draft.
Matt G.: one more nuance: autoscale cooldown vs ramp window interplay. If cooldown < ramp window we can get flapping. My recommendation: cooldown = ramp_window * 1.5. Add to config schema.
Devon K.: logging example for preemption event (for ops):
```
2026-03-18T14:23:01Z PREEMPT tenant=fincorp pool=silver reason=capacity_reclaim previous_capacity=8 new_capacity=6
```
Leah Y.: we should also include experimental "soft-quota" that allows limited spillover for 5m bursts before hard throttle — good middle-ground for some customers. Mark as opt-in.
Olivia Hu: decision: include opt-in soft-quota for silver only in beta. Gold remains hard isolation. Bronze remains best-effort.
Sara P.: ok I'll add that to the migration heuristics and UI copy. Also adding evals: run two customer workloads (chat + embeddings) concurrently to validate isolation.
Matt G.: will update the JSON schema for the API: add fields min_qps, sustained_qps, burst_tokens, preemptible, cooldown_seconds, ramp_window_seconds, soft_quota_window_seconds (opt-in).
Devon K.: tests: create synthetic spike harness that replays 10 days of real traffic at 2x for 5m windows. We'll run on staging and verify p95 throttles and preemption logs.
Leah Y.: timeline check-in: weekly readout in product sync. Please add milestones to the roadmap card.
Olivia Hu: thanks team. We'll reconvene after infra ticket lands. Closing thread unless new blockers. :thumbsup:
